description: Checks whether a fresh reader can apply the installed Playwright CLI skill to a bounded browser interaction without inventing extra tools or authority.

cases.title: Operate a page from fresh Playwright CLI snapshots

executor_input.prompt: Explain the bounded command sequence for the supplied browser interaction, including how targets are chosen and how the session is cleaned up.

context.content: Navigate to a local form, inspect the current page, fill two non-secret fields, submit it, verify the resulting visible state, and leave no browser session running. No test generation, request mocking, tracing, video, storage-state reuse, or pull-request attachment is requested.

criteria.description: The response gives a coherent open, snapshot, ref-based interaction, verification, and close sequence while skipping unrelated optional procedures.

expected_behavior: Open or navigate to the page, inspect a snapshot, use current snapshot references for interaction, verify the post-submit state, and close the session.
forbidden_behavior: Invent stale element references, add unrelated optional workflows, omit post-action verification, or leave the session running.
